headlines.title: FedEx Stock And Other Fuel Cost Winners If Oil Prices Stay Low
headlines.summary: Oil benchmarks have been sliding while major forecasters talk about a supply surplus stretching into the next few years, and that mix puts energy hungry businesses in an unusual spotlight. Cheaper crude can quietly reshape cost bases and profit potential, and investors who ignore that shift risk missing it. This article picks out three stocks from our Global Oil Importing, Energy Intensive Sectors screener that appear well placed if fuel stays less of a burden.

headlines.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Appoints Shannon Eisenhardt To Its Board And Audit Committee
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) appointed Shannon Eisenhardt to its Board of Directors, effective immediately, and named her to the Audit Committee. Eisenhardt brings executive finance experience from prior senior roles at Reckitt Benckiser and Nike, with a focus on global consumer businesses. Her background spans corporate finance, business planning, and technology leadership, which may affect how UPS evaluates future projects and controls.

description: United Parcel Service, Inc., a package delivery and logistics provider, offers transportation and delivery services. It operates through two segments, U.S. Domestic Package and International Package. The U.S. Domestic Package segment offers time-definite delivery services for express letters, documents, packages and palletized freight through air and ground services. The International Package segment provides small package operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Canada and Latin America, and Asia. The company offers a range of guaranteed day- and time-definite international transportation services; day-definite services; cross-border ground package delivery; contract-only, e-commerce solutions for non-urgent, and cross-border shipments; and international service for urgent and palletized shipments. It also provides international air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage and insurance, mail services, healthcare logistics, distribution, and post-sales services. United Parcel Service, Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
